page.notes: Printed text is set in two columns; the left column is listed first, then the right. Left-hand "ticus 163" and "Othonis, Friderici imp." belong to the right column, which begins "ticus 163" as the continuation of "Otho ... Othonis" entries. Long s is read as s throughout. Several lines are cut at the right edge or at the foot of the page; the last line "cle" is partly cut off and uncertain. The entry "Ofuualdus" has a doubtful first letter (O with a long-s-like form), and "Oruietum" appears with u for consonant v. Numbers are copied as printed; "Os porci" line numbers may be incomplete at the cut edge. Some numbers (for example "276" and "263") are close to the scan and not fully certain.
